device_entry.name: RPLIDAR激光雷达
tags: 移动机器人与自动驾驶实验
device_entry.description: 用于机器人环境感知的二维激光雷达。该设备通过连续扫描获取距离与角度测量数据，可用于避障、定位、建图和周围环境轮廓检测。
device_entry.description_en: A 2D LiDAR sensor for robot environment perception. It continuously scans to acquire distance and angle measurements, enabling obstacle avoidance, localization, mapping, and surrounding scene detection.
